visual_enhancers.shadows: Very subtle ambient shadows for cards. 'shadow-sm' on cards, 'shadow-md' for dropdowns and modals.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E3E7E4 (border_subtle) on all cards and containers.
visual_enhancers.radius: Rounded corners: 'rounded-xl' for main cards, 'rounded-lg' for inner elements/buttons, 'rounded-md' for small badges.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous padding inside cards ('p-6' or 'p-8'). High density grid gap 'gap-6'.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Not recommended for this standard accounting app unless for sticky headers ('bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md'). Use flat solid surfaces mostly.

layouts.app_shell: Left Sidebar Navigation + Top Header + Main Content Area. Sidebar is collapsible. Top-left for North Star metric/Greeting.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid Mode B (High Density Grid). 4-column layout ('grid-cols-4'). Stat cards take 1 column each. Main tables take 'col-span-full' or 'col-span-3'.
layouts.case_workspace: Tabbed layout for Overview, Tasks, Documents, Messages, Tax Working, Internal Notes, Activity. Split pane if needed (Table on left, Details on right).

components.cards: Clean white background (#FFFFFF), 1px subtle border (#E3E7E4), no heavy shadows, generous internal padding (p-6).
components.badges: Clear status badges. Use soft background of the status color with darker text (e.g. bg-success/10 text-success).
components.tables: Tabular layout with sticky headers. Left aligned columns. 'border-b' on rows. Use distinct hover state ('hover:bg-background_main').
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg. Primary action uses '#078A4B'. No excessive gradients.
components.stepper: Client tax journey stepper: horizontally laid out steps with clear active/completed/upcoming states using primary green and subtle borders.
components.navigation: Left nav. Selected item uses '#EAF5EE' with bold text and primary icon color.

motion.transitions: Simple, functional. 'transition-colors duration-200' for hovers. No unnecessary scaling or bouncing animations.
motion.loading: Skeleton loaders matching the shape of the content, or simple spinners in Primary Green.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast on buttons. #FFFFFF on #078A4B is accessible.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings ('focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50 focus:outline-none') on all inputs and buttons.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.

media.images: Not heavily requested. Use standard user avatars or simple document illustrations if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind with the exact custom color palette provided.
Use Shadcn UI components heavily customized to have subtle borders, no aggressive shadows, and white backgrounds.
Structure the dashboards using a Sidebar + Header + Main Area layout.
For the case tables, ensure robust filtering and clear status badges (19 states means a reusable Badge component with varying colors is critical).
Strictly follow the 'no unnecessary animations' rule. Stick to opacity and color transitions only.
Apply 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, inputs, and tab triggers.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Left-align most dashboard content for readability.
Ensure generous spacing: avoid cramped text or widgets.
Use predefined color variables instead of hardcoded hex values in classes.
Do not apply universal 'transition: all'. Apply to specific properties like background-color or border-color.
Never use transparent backgrounds on elements that have content beneath them, such as dropdown menus or sticky headers.
